field_checks.summary: Primary XML/PDF Table 1 was independently parsed with rowspans. The positive purified SM07 MIC row is source-supported as 4 ug/mL against Pseudomonas aeruginosa ATCC27853, but several SM07 selectivity/exclusion rows do not preserve source target/strain exactly: BAA747 is dropped as not_reported and ESCCO ATCC 25922 is silently normalized to Escherichia coli.

Authoritative DBAASP/merged linked rows are absent, and the only DBAASP rows are machine fallback candidates with sequence None. The current final keeps them unresolved, with source_verified_count 0 and authoritative ingest false, so the release boundary is preserved but database linkage is not authoritative.

All core final release mirrors were reviewed. Paper and packet finals are byte-identical for activity_toxicity_evidence, database_record_verification, mechanism_ontology_record, and review_report; packet mechanism_evidence is the expected alias of mechanism_ontology_record. Live packet open rework ticket count is 0 and matches the strict acceptance status.

Mechanism claims preserve evidence-strength boundaries: computational_only, phenotype_supported, inferred_mechanism, and unknown_or_not_tested are separated, and no direct_mechanism claim is made without a direct assay.

Paper identity is consistent across XML, packet manifest, database manifest, and strict audit: PMC13025223, DOI 10.3390/cimb48030318, PMID 41899469, title about SM07 against P. aeruginosa. SM07 identity is paper-local, but no authoritative database sequence/literature linkage exists.

All requested directories/files were readable, and no object with both a plain one-letter sequence and sequence_length was found. Activity value/unit normalization for the positive MIC is direct, but Table 1 target normalization is not fully source-preserving for BAA747 and ESCCO ATCC 25922 selectivity rows.

Recursive authority repair is current: source_locator fields in final scientific records do not point to project artifact paths, and fallback DBAASP rows are not promoted to source_verified, RC2, portal, or authoritative ingest.

Existing cautions preserve DBAASP fallback and absent supplements, but the final activity/selectivity layer does not preserve all source target conflicts/cautions: ESCCO ATCC 25922 is normalized without an ambiguity caution, and BAA747 is omitted from Acinetobacter baumannii rows.

Primary XML/PDF and staged supplement surfaces were inspected. Source and packet supplementary directories are empty; supplementary_index, supplementary_text, supplementary_tables, and archive_manifest report zero files/tables/text/archive members; XML contains no supplementary-material/media/app nodes requiring extraction.

Toxicity is kept qualitative with explicit approximate_not_extracted status for Figure 6, which is acceptable. Selectivity coverage is not publication-grade because Table 1 SM07 ND rows retain values and locators but not all source target/strain strings exactly.

blocking_findings.reason: Worker-2/final activity_toxicity_evidence fails field-level source preservation for Table 1 selectivity/exclusion targets. Independent parsing of the primary XML table shows body-row 4 and 5 inherit source target Acinetobacter baumannii BAA747, but final EXCL-004 and EXCL-005 set target_strain_or_isolate to not_reported. The same parse shows body-row 9 and 10 inherit source target ESCCO ATCC 25922, but final EXCL-009 and EXCL-010 silently normalize this to Escherichia coli / ATCC25922 without a raw source label, ambiguity status, or source-backed normalization rationale. The positive P. aeruginosa MIC is correct, but publication-grade target/strain and source-conflict coverage cannot pass while these source table fields are unsupported or omitted.
required_actions: Rebuild the Table 1 activity/selectivity exclusions from the primary XML/PDF table with rowspan propagation and preserve a raw source target label for every row.
For Acinetobacter baumannii rows, carry BAA747 as the strain/isolate or explicitly document why it cannot be normalized while retaining the raw source target.

For ESCCO ATCC 25922 rows, either preserve the target as an ambiguous raw source label or provide a paper-local source locator that supports normalizing it to Escherichia coli; do not silently normalize it.
Mirror the repaired activity_toxicity_evidence to paper and packet finals and update worker-6 review/adjudication counts after repair.
acceptance_checks: A table parser over xml:table-wrap:1 with rowspan propagation finds 12 SM07 table rows represented in activity_records plus structured exclusions, with each final row carrying raw source target, treatment, value/ND status, and source_cell_locator.

No final Table 1 SM07 row sourced from Acinetobacter baumannii BAA747 has target_strain_or_isolate set to not_reported unless raw_source_target preserves BAA747 and the unresolved rationale is explicit.
Final EXCL-009 and EXCL-010 preserve ESCCO ATCC 25922 as raw source target and mark normalization ambiguous/unresolved unless a concrete paper-local locator supports Escherichia coli normalization.

Paper and packet final activity_toxicity_evidence.json are byte-identical after repair; semantic_three_layer_gate.py and an independent Table 1 target-field audit return zero issues; live packet open_rework_ticket_count equals the strict acceptance artifact status.

cautions.summary: The paper has no linked authoritative DBAASP/merged sequence, assay, article, or literature rows. Current finals correctly keep fallback machine rows unresolved and authoritative ingest not ready.
No staged standalone supplementary assets are present; this is not itself a blocker because the XML/PDF contain the relevant activity, toxicity, and mechanism surfaces reviewed here.
